purpose: build a mobile app that works on real devices, handles poor networks and respects each platform's rules
entry_criteria: Target platforms and versions are chosen
Test devices or a device farm are available
procedure: Pick the approach (native, cross-platform) based on the needs and the team's skills, and record the reason.
Build features in small slices and test each on real devices as well as simulators.
Design for poor connectivity: cache sensible data, queue writes, retry with limits and show clear status.
Handle the app lifecycle: backgrounding, interruptions, permission refusal and low memory.
Store sensitive data in the platform's secure storage, request only needed permissions and explain them to the user.
Check the store policies, app size, startup time and battery use before release, and plan staged rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Features work on the supported OS versions and real devices
Behavior without a network is defined and tested

validation.check: run the main flows on one low-end and one current device with airplane mode toggled
validation.expect: flows complete or fail with a clear message

validation.check: review the requested permissions against the features that use them

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A delivery app queues status updates while offline and retries when the network returns; location permission is requested only when the user opens the map, with a message explaining why.
